source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What information initially helps an agent choose a relevant skill from a catalog?

options.text: The catalog names and short descriptions
options.feedback: These give the agent an initial account of each skill's purpose and applicability before loading detailed instructions.

options.text: The full procedure of every installed skill
options.feedback: The detailed procedure is loaded after a skill is selected. Requiring every complete procedure would defeat staged loading.

options.text: A ranking by when the skills were installed
options.feedback: Installation order does not establish whether a procedure fits the requested work. The description supplies relevance information.

options.text: The largest collection of bundled examples
options.feedback: Many examples may help a procedure, but their number does not identify whether its purpose matches the task.
